name: 警官と讃美歌(Z2 Standard・学習コーナー)

p_15040a7dfa.sentence: He did not want to live on the streets any longer.
p_15040a7dfa.prev: Tomorrow, he would ask that man for work again.
p_15040a7dfa.next: He wanted to change his life.

p_e63005fd9f.sentence: He planned to eat, say he could not pay, and wait for the police.
p_e63005fd9f.prev: First, he entered an expensive restaurant.
p_e63005fd9f.next: But a waiter saw his old trousers and pushed him outside.

p_57d4cb4167.sentence: People who broke windows ran away.
p_57d4cb4167.prev: The policeman did not believe him.
p_57d4cb4167.next: Another man was running to catch a bus.

p_27079e22b4.sentence: The policeman ran after that man instead.
p_27079e22b4.prev: Another man was running to catch a bus.
p_27079e22b4.next: At a cheaper restaurant, Soapy got a table.

p_f1ecd7ab58.sentence: Instead, the waiters threw him out.
p_f1ecd7ab58.next: A policeman nearby watched and laughed.

p_4868a1f8e0.sentence: In those days, he had a home.
p_4868a1f8e0.prev: Long ago, he had heard it with his mother.
p_4868a1f8e0.next: He remembered his friends and the flowers outside the house.

p_5661429913.sentence: Soapy looked at his dirty hands.
p_5661429913.prev: The music filled the quiet night.

p_b4a8f3a5e3.next: The next morning, Soapy stood before a judge.

p_7b38566904.sentence: “He’s a student having fun,” a policeman told someone walking past.
p_7b38566904.prev: Outside a theatre, Soapy danced and shouted loudly.

p_648a473f4a.sentence: On the way, he passed an old church.
p_648a473f4a.prev: He started walking back towards his bench.
p_648a473f4a.next: Warm light came through a window.

p_e8426ca3f1.next: A leaf fell onto Soapy’s knees.
